% Pattern: env/empty-title. An environment with no title, as
% \newtheorem{subsec}[equation]{}, whose body leads with a bold title of a
% known kind, as {\bf Notation.} or {\bf Proof of Theorem \ref{a}.}, is of that
% kind; a lead of no known kind leaves it as it was.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1 labels=a
% want subsec-1 definition/notation 2
% want subsec-2 proof 3 proves=thm-1
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{subsec}[thm]{}
\begin{document}
\begin{thm}\label{a} Each tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges. \end{thm}
\begin{subsec}{\bf Notation.} We write $T$ for a tree. \end{subsec}
\begin{subsec}{\bf Proof of Theorem \ref{a}.} Remove a leaf. \end{subsec}
\end{document}
